svg.title: fly-favicon - ten styles, ready to try in your tab
svg.desc: A hand-drawn workflow shows a website leading to ten SVG favicon candidates. An orange cat is selected, checked at 16, 24, and 32 pixels, and appears in a browser tab beside a downloadable SVG file.
